narration: Your trading app looks exactly like a game — streaks, charts, coins flying up. What the UI doesn't show you? Ninety-seven percent of day traders lose money within two years.
visual: Phone SVG showing trading app with green chart, streak badge, floating gold coins; large red '97%' stat appears below phone, dark background

narration: Researchers tracked sixteen hundred traders for five years — only three percent made a sustainable profit. And active traders underperform the market by six-and-a-half percent every single year.
visual: Tall red bar labeled '97% Lose Money' vs tiny green bar labeled '3% Profit' on a bar chart, light background; '6.5% below market' badge fades in below

narration: Here's what they don't advertise — your app earns on every trade, win or lose. The more you trade, the richer they get. That's just their business model.
visual: Person silhouette with phone on left, animated gold coins moving right along dashed arrow track toward office building labeled 'APP', dark background

narration: Early wins feel like proof you're skilled. That's the hot hand fallacy — your brain literally can't tell luck from skill. Traders who win early bet bigger and crash harder.
visual: Gold dice showing six on left; person silhouette with thought bubble 'I'm good at this!' on right; red downward arrow pops in; light background

narration: Day trader with ten thousand dollars loses thirty-four hundred in year one. Index fund investor: gains twelve hundred. That's a four-thousand-six-hundred-dollar gap — compounded for decades.

narration: The boring truth? A simple index fund you barely touch beats ninety-two percent of professionals over twenty years. Stop playing the game and start winning the war. Follow for more.
